# Phase 03.1: Fix the #64/#61 transitive-staleness false-green and flip the flagship lock to green - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-07-02
**Status:** Ready for planning
**Mode:** Auto-generated from Phase 3's authoritative diagnosis (03-RESEARCH.md / 03-VERIFICATION.md) — this is a surgical fix phase whose target was empirically pinned by Phase 3; the fix approach is forced by correctness, not open taste.

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Fix the one defect Phase 3 captured and locked RED — a false `ok-complete` from `agda_load_no_metas` on a transitive-staleness truncation — and flip the flagship regression from RED to locked, proving the capture → lock → **fix** → stay-locked loop closes end-to-end.

**In scope:** the `runLoadNoMetas` completion-detection gap only, plus the one-line matrix-status flip that the fix makes pass.

**Out of scope:** every other loop-surfaced defect (they are Phase 4 fix-queue items), and any broad re-architecture of completion detection.
</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### D-01 — Fix surface (FORCED by Phase 3 research)
The defect is in `runLoadNoMetas` (`src/agda/session-load-impl.ts:198-200`), which calls `sendCommand` with no options — no `awaitGoalTerminus`/fail-closed guard — while the metas path `runLoad` (`session-load-impl.ts:83-87`) passes `{ awaitGoalTerminus: true }` and reports `load-incomplete-no-terminus` (a failure) when the terminus never arrives (`loadIncompleteNoTerminus()` in `src/agda/session-load-helpers.ts:69-83`). The root cause is the transport completion-detection asymmetry between the two load-family paths (`e38f90a` fixed only the metas path) — NOT `agdai-cache.ts` / `forceRecompile` (empirically ruled out in 03-RESEARCH.md). The fix extends a fail-closed terminus/completion guard to `runLoadNoMetas`; the completion machinery lives in `src/session/command-completion.ts` and `src/session/agda-transport.ts`.

### D-02 — The terminus must be a `Cmd_load_no_metas`-appropriate VARIANT (correctness-critical; resolve in research)
`Cmd_load_no_metas` legitimately emits **no** `InteractionPoints`/`AllGoalsWarnings` — so a naive `awaitGoalTerminus: true` copy (which waits for exactly those) would false-RED every genuinely goal-less strict load and break the fast path. The 03.1 research pass MUST determine, empirically against a real Agda binary, the correct completion signal that (a) catches a stream truncated before a terminal load event (the #65/#66 mechanism) yet (b) treats a legitimate no-goal completion as success. This is the single genuinely-open design question of the phase; everything else is forced. (This mirrors how Phase 3 resolved its own central question by direct empirical reproduction.)

### D-03 — Definition of done (FORCED by phase goal)
The `issue-64-61-transitive-staleness` entry in `test/fixtures/capture-regression-matrix.json` flips `status: "red"` → `status: "locked"`. The generic runner (`test/integration/mcp/capture-regression.test.ts`) then asserts `matchesExpected(observed, expected) === true` — i.e., the warm `agda_load_no_metas` reload under the pathological idle env now reports the cold-correct outcome (`type-error` / a fail-closed classification) instead of the false `ok-complete`. This flip, going green, IS the end-to-end proof.

### D-04 — Scope fence (FORCED by charter / STATE blockers)
Fix ONLY the `runLoadNoMetas` terminus gap. Do NOT touch the three other live CHG-REVERIFY defects (`agda_auto` CLI-flag leak; `agda_give` `ok:true`-wrapping-error; `agda_search_definitions` hardcoded layout) — those are Phase 4 fix-queue ammo. Do NOT rewrite the idle-timeout heuristic or the metas path.

### D-05 — No regression + minimality (FORCED)
The metas path (`agda_load`/`agda_typecheck`) stays byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged and still fails closed; small/fast strict loads still succeed; the full suite stays green. Add a guard test proving a legitimately goal-less `agda_load_no_metas` completion is NOT false-RED'd by the new terminus logic (the D-02 risk). Honor the 500-line `src/` ceiling and the command-builder SSOT.

### Claude's Discretion
The exact terminus-signal implementation (subject to D-02's empirical finding), the precise classification returned on truncation (reuse `load-incomplete-no-terminus` vs a no_metas-specific sibling), and the guard-test fixture shape.
</decisions>
